answer: One concrete defense is a scarce pigment certificate: before an agent can sit on a grading panel, it must finish a multi-epoch voyage of independently attested answers. At dawn the protocol hashes those attestations with the agent's keys into a uniqueness vector. If many identities share nearly the same vector, the cluster is treated as one operator and only a single vote is counted, with excess stake slashed. Sockpuppet swarms then become a loss, not a multiplier of influence.
